target: fatal accidents involving Boeing commercial jets

evidence.publisher: Komite Nasional Keselamatan Transportasi (KNKT), Republic of Indonesia
evidence.observation: KNKT identifies the 9 January 2021 accident as Sriwijaya Air flight SJY182, Boeing 737-500 PK-CLC, operating a scheduled passenger flight from Jakarta to Pontianak.

evidence.scope: IATA accident taxonomy / global commercial aviation
evidence.observation: IATA independently lists Sriwijaya Air B737-500 on 9 January 2021 as a jet hull-loss accident with 62 onboard fatalities and loss-of-control-in-flight category.
The annual accident summary lists SJY182 as B737-500 PK-CLC, passenger, jet, hull loss; other listed Boeing jet occurrences in the inspected annual table are nonfatal in the visible records.

completeness_assessment.reason: SJY182 is supported by a competent investigation authority and independent IATA evidence, but the complete 2021 global fatal-jet set and all potential Boeing target cases have not yet been independently reconciled under the fixed BSFM scope.
